title: Fireside Chat: Africa’s Critical Mineral Production: Poised for Rapid Growth
gist: Video page for a Giga Africa 2026 fireside chat on Africa's rapidly growing critical mineral production, with a session list covering lithium, graphite, copper, storage and EVs. The text is only descriptions with no data, so the card is light.

insights.claim: Benchmark Mineral Intelligence's Giga Africa 2026 fireside chat, with Zimbabwe's Ministry of Mines Chief Director Leon Godza and Benchmark COO Caspar Rawles, frames Africa's critical mineral production as expanding rapidly, with investment and value-chain development opportunities.
insights.speaker: Leon Godza (Ministry of Mines of Zimbabwe); Caspar Rawles (Benchmark Mineral Intelligence)
insights.so_what: Watch Zimbabwe and wider African policy and project news for lithium and other battery-material supply additions.

insights.claim: The session positions Africa as playing a growing role in the global supply of materials essential to the energy transition.
insights.speaker: Leon Godza (Ministry of Mines of Zimbabwe); Caspar Rawles (Benchmark Mineral Intelligence)
insights.so_what: Africa is a rising supply-diversification source for battery and energy-transition materials.

insights.claim: A Giga Africa 2026 lithium panel covers Africa's growing lithium resources, project pipeline and increasing role in global battery supply chains, including investment and development opportunities across the value chain.
insights.speaker: Leon Godza (Ministry of Mines of Zimbabwe); Caspar Rawles (Benchmark Mineral Intelligence)
insights.so_what: African lithium projects are an investable pipeline to track for supply growth.

insights.claim: A Giga Africa 2026 panel asks what it actually takes to build graphite and anode capacity outside China, implying non-China supply chains are hard to execute.
insights.speaker: Leon Godza (Ministry of Mines of Zimbabwe); Caspar Rawles (Benchmark Mineral Intelligence)
insights.so_what: Non-China anode capacity faces execution hurdles; scrutinize project timelines.

insights.claim: Giga Africa 2026 includes a keynote mapping Africa's battery storage pipeline and future energy storage demand, plus a panel on OEM and EV market growth and adoption trends across Africa.
insights.speaker: Leon Godza (Ministry of Mines of Zimbabwe); Caspar Rawles (Benchmark Mineral Intelligence)
insights.so_what: Signals emerging African demand for storage and EVs alongside supply.
insights.locator: Keynote: Visualising Africa's Battery Storage Pipeline

insights.claim: The event program also features a copper market outlook on supply and demand dynamics and commodity updates on copper and graphite; the page gives no figures.
insights.speaker: Leon Godza (Ministry of Mines of Zimbabwe); Caspar Rawles (Benchmark Mineral Intelligence)
insights.so_what: Copper and graphite views are in the full sessions only; this page offers no numbers.

source_meta.author: Leon Godza , Chief Director , Ministry of Mines of Zimbabwe; Caspar Rawles , Chief Operating Officer , Benchmark Mineral
